source: closed-form from Buildings CDL sources; re-derivation from Buildings CDL sources sharing the pinned libm kernel / documented recurrence with the engine
compare_regime: aligned finite-Real tolerance for transcendental outputs; Inf/NaN by IEEE class
input: u=[-Inf,0,-0,-1,1,10,1000,+Inf,NaN]; documented invalid domain and decimal anchors
reference_rule: y = Modelica.Math.log10(u), evaluated with deterministic libm 0.2.16; Buildings docs require u > 0, and Open Control Engine warns for invalid runtime rows
math_library: libm 0.2.16, default-features=false, pure Rust deterministic math
format: Modelica CombiTimeTable CSV (_spec/07 §9); signal CSV is time+one output; reference.csv is time+inputs+all outputs; ryu shortest-round-trip f64
